I'm something of an amateur metallurgy enthusiast. When it comes to chef knives, my dream is something not too different to yours, with a mix of western chef and santoku properties. Metals wise, I'd like it in a steel called cru-wear, or in magnacut. Edge geometry matters more than steel for toughness and edge retention properties (TL;DR fancy steels don't matter as much as knife nerds think they do), but it's still nice to have something that absolutely blows common use chef knife steels out of the water, and both of those are incredible steels for chef knives. 
Shame it's hard to find cru-wear anywhere other than custom smiths. But you can find magnacut chefs for around 200-300 usd and still know they'll be useable in a kitchen in a century or two.
